[[File:CROUS-mango.jpg|thumbnail|Is learning to cook an example of maintenance learning or [[innovative learning]]?]]
'''Maintenance learning''' refers to [[learning]] aimed at encountering known and well-defined existing situations.

On the collective scale, it contributes to the maintenance of social structure and the associated, established way of life.<ref>{{#cite:Q2658}}</ref>

== Prevalence ==

=== The comfortable default ===

According to ''[[Source:No Limits to Learning (Book)|Botkin et al.]]'', '''maintenance learning''' is a frequent default for both individuals and societies, as human beings are naturally resistant to change and [[uncertainty]].<ref>{{#cite:Q2658}}</ref>
